description: This source file contains functions for validating and parsing Wi-Fi configuration parameters, especially related to Passpoint, interworking, radius settings, enterprise security, and SSID validation in a Wi-Fi management system.

classes.name: wifi_interworking_t
classes.description: Structure representing Wi-Fi interworking information used in Passpoint validation.

classes.name: wifi_vap_info_t
classes.description: Structure representing Wi-Fi VAP (Virtual Access Point) information used in various validation functions.

classes.name: pErr
classes.description: Pointer to an error structure used to report validation error messages.

methods.name: int validate_ipv4_address(char * ip)
methods.description: Validates whether a given string is a valid IPv4 address.

methods.name: int validate_ipv6_address(char * ip)
methods.description: Validates whether a given string is a valid IPv6 address.

methods.name: int validate_anqp(const cJSON * anqp,wifi_interworking_t * vap_info,pErr execRetVal)
methods.description: Validates and processes the ANQP (Access Network Query Protocol) elements within a Passpoint configuration, updating internal structures and generating statistics.

methods.name: int validate_passpoint(const cJSON * passpoint,wifi_interworking_t * vap_info,pErr execRetVal)
methods.description: Validates Passpoint-specific configurations, including enabling/disabling, operator name, capabilities, and associated ANQP and Passpoint elements.

methods.name: int validate_interworking(const cJSON * interworking,wifi_vap_info_t * vap_info,pErr execRetVal)
methods.description: Validates the interworking element of a Wi-Fi configuration, including interworking parameters, venue info, ANQP, and Passpoint data.

methods.name: int early_validate_interworking(const cJSON * interworking,pErr execRetVal)
methods.description: Performs preliminary validation of interworking parameters without complex data processing.

methods.name: int validate_radius_settings(const cJSON * radius,wifi_vap_info_t * vap_info,pErr execRetVal)
methods.description: Validates radius server configuration parameters, including IP addresses, ports, secrets, and related security parameters.

methods.name: int validate_enterprise_security(const cJSON * security,wifi_vap_info_t * vap_info,pErr execRetVal)
methods.description: Validates enterprise security configuration parameters including mode, encryption, MFP, and radius settings.

methods.name: int validate_personal_security(const cJSON * security,wifi_vap_info_t * vap_info,pErr execRetVal)
methods.description: Validates personal security configuration, primarily encryption method and passphrase.

methods.name: int validate_ssid_name(char * ssid_name,pErr execRetVal)
methods.description: Checks that the SSID name is valid, length within limits, and contains only printable characters.

methods.name: int validate_xfinity_secure_vap(const cJSON * vap,wifi_vap_info_t * vap_info,pErr execRetVal)
methods.description: Validates secure Xfinity Wi-Fi VAP configuration, including security, interworking, and Passpoint parameters.

methods.name: int validate_xfinity_open_vap(const cJSON * vap,wifi_vap_info_t * vap_info,pErr execRetVal)
methods.description: Validates open Xfinity Wi-Fi VAP configuration, including security mode, MFP, interworking, and Passpoint parameters.

methods.name: int validate_private_vap(const cJSON * vap,wifi_vap_info_t * vap_info,pErr execRetVal)
methods.description: Validates private (personal) Wi-Fi VAP configuration with security mode, encryption, MFP, and related parameters.

methods.name: int validate_contry_code(wifi_countrycode_type_t * contry_code,char * contry)
methods.description: Validates the country code string against known map, sets internal code if matched.

methods.name: int validate_vap(const cJSON * vap,wifi_vap_info_t * vap_info,wifi_platform_property_t * wifi_prop,pErr execRetVal)
methods.description: Validates and extracts parameters for a VAP configuration, including SSID, security, passpoint, and various other parameters; also invokes specific validation based on vap type.

methods.name: int validate_wifi_global_config(const cJSON * global_cfg,wifi_global_param_t * global_info,pErr execRetVal)
methods.description: Validates global Wi-Fi configuration parameters.

methods.name: int wifi_validate_config(const cJSON * root_json,wifi_global_config_t * wifi_config,wifi_vap_info_map_t * vap_map,wifi_radio_operationParam_t * radio_vap_map,wifi_radio_feature_param_t * radio_feat_map,char * num_of_radio,wifi_platform_property_t * wifi_prop,pErr execRetVal)
methods.description: Validates overall Wi-Fi configuration JSON, including GAS, global parameters, and VAPs.

methods.name: int validate_gas_config(const cJSON * gas,wifi_GASConfiguration_t * gas_info,pErr execRetVal)
methods.description: Validates GAS (Generic Advertisement Service) configuration parameters.

methods.name: int validate_wifi_channel(wifi_freq_bands_t wifi_band,UINT * wifi_radio_channel,UINT wifi_channel)
methods.description: Validates Wi-Fi channel number based on frequency band.

methods.name: int validate_radio_vap(const cJSON * wifi,wifi_radio_operationParam_t * wifi_radio_info,wifi_vap_info_map_t * vap_map,wifi_radio_feature_param_t * wifi_radio_feat_info,pErr execRetVal)
methods.description: Validates radio operation parameters including frequency band, channels, channels list, channel width, hardware mode, and various radio-specific parameters.

methods.name: int validate_wifi_config(const cJSON * wifi,wifi_global_config_t * wifi_info,pErr execRetVal)
methods.description: Validates Wi-Fi configuration including radio and VAP config sections.

methods.name: wifi_validate_config
methods.description: Main entry point to validate entire Wi-Fi configuration JSON, calling sub-validations and populating internal data structures.
